title: Transport-independent claim/lease protocol (Gherkin)
description:
## Goal

Specify one transport-independent claim/lease protocol in Gherkin. This is the source of truth. Python and Rust implement it later; no implementation-only tests, no Python-only or Rust-only PRs.

## Must specify

- Resource identity, owner identity, claim IDs
- Contention window vs lease TTL (separate concepts)
- Heartbeat/renewal, expiration, release/completion
- Deterministic collision resolution
- Failure and partition behavior at each provider strength
- Git-only remains fully functional (missing MQTT or Mutex API is not an error)
- Worker API: ask Kanbus to claim; Kanbus selects the strongest configured provider
- Do not conflate with existing `kbs update --claim` (assignee + in_progress)

## Acceptance

Gherkin scenarios exist and are the contract. Dual-runtime work is blocked until these scenarios are accepted.
